en.askTitle: Swap in your own dates, ages and budget, and get the same gentle Vietnam route checked against official pages
en.runTitle: Retired couple from Busan, 15 days in Vietnam on KRW 6 million (flights excluded)

fields.label: Dates
fields.value: 3–17 March 2027, flying into Hanoi and out of Ho Chi Minh City

fields.label: Travellers’ ages, passports and residence
fields.value: Retired couple from Busan, both 66, South Korean passports

fields.label: Walking/boarding needs
fields.value: They walk well, but no long overnight bus rides and no more than one early-morning start in a row

en.template: Plan a gentle Vietnam trip for {dates}, {travellers}, with {needs} and {budget}. Compare Hanoi, a bay overnight, Hue, Hoi An and a Mekong day trip. Keep two domestic flights, no overnight buses, rest days and a Hanoi night after the cruise. Check late breakfast and optional dawn excursions, all-in two-person quotes, entry/declaration rules and suitable insurance. Keep a 15% contingency and separate dated examples from available offers. Ask before contacting anyone, sharing information, applying or paying.

phases.title: Check entry rules, transport, hotels, cruises and insurance against official pages
phases.note: Entry rules, transport, hotel and cruise examples, and over-65 insurance in parallel
phases.judgment: It would not smooth over a disagreement: the official sources differ on whether the arrival declaration is mandatory or only strongly encouraged, so the guide flags it as unresolved and says to recheck before travel.

phases.title: Write the guide and a source list for every rule and price
phases.note: Route, transport comparison, itinerary with rest days, budget in VND and KRW
phases.judgment: It reported conflicts in its own transport sources: the official scenic-train page has conflicting timetable blocks, and a car operator’s “free scenic stops” claim contradicts its own surcharge table. Train fares from the primary site could not be confirmed, so alternatives are clearly marked.

phases.title: Independently recompute the money figures and test the page on desktop and phone
phases.judgment: The independent check recomputed 38 money examples and all 22 budget rows: total KRW 5,315,556, leaving KRW 684,444 of the KRW 6 million. It also said what it could not certify: because some early page fetches silently went through an already-open browser, it could not be confirmed that every page was read in a fresh, signed-out browser.

workers: Verified entry rules for South Korean passports, March weather by region and insurance options for over-65s
Found hotel examples in four cities on the hotels’ own pages and compared two overnight Ha Long cruises
Compared domestic flights, the Reunification train, car transfers and Mekong tours, with dated fares and journey times
Recomputed every money figure on its own and checked each claim against the source list

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的日期、年龄和预算，得到同样对照官方页面核过的轻松越南行程
zh.runTitle: 釜山退休夫妇，15 天越南行，预算 600 万韩元（不含机票）

fields.label: 日期
fields.value: 2027 年 3 月 3 日至 17 日，河内入境、胡志明市出境

fields.label: 旅客年龄、护照和居住地
fields.value: 釜山退休夫妇，两人都是 66 岁，持韩国护照

fields.label: 步行及上下船需求
fields.value: 走路没问题，但不想坐长途夜班大巴，也不想连着多天清晨出发

zh.template: 请为{dates}、{travellers}安排轻松的越南游，考虑{needs}和{budget}。比较河内、海湾过夜、顺化、会安及湄公河一日游；保留两段国内航班，不坐过夜巴士，安排休息日和下船后的河内住宿。核对晚早餐、可跳过的清晨活动、两人全包报价、入境和申报规则及合适保险。保留15%机动金，把有日期的示例与确实可买的产品分开。联系他人、分享资料、申请或付款前先问我。

phases.title: 对照官方页面核对入境规定、交通、酒店、游轮和保险
phases.note: 入境规定、交通、酒店与游轮示例、65 岁以上保险同时进行
phases.judgment: 官方说法有出入时它不会含糊带过：到达申报到底是强制还是“强烈建议”，各官方来源说法不一，所以指南标为“未解决”，并提醒出发前再核。

phases.title: 写成指南，并为每条规定和价格列出来源
phases.note: 路线、交通对比、含休息日的行程，以及越南盾与韩元预算
phases.judgment: 它把自己查到的交通信息里的矛盾如实报了出来：官方景观火车页面的时刻表前后冲突，某家包车公司宣传的“免费景观停靠”又与自家加收价目表相矛盾；铁路官网上的票价未能确认，所以替代来源都明确标注。

phases.title: 独立重算所有金额，并用电脑和手机宽度测试页面
phases.judgment: 独立复核重算了 38 个金额示例和全部 22 行预算：总计 5,315,556 韩元，在 600 万韩元里还剩 684,444 韩元。它也说明了做不到的部分：早期有几次网页读取悄悄走了已有的浏览器，所以无法严格保证全程都是干净的浏览环境。

workers: 核实韩国护照的入境规定、各地区三月天气，以及 65 岁以上的保险选择
在酒店自家页面上找四个城市的酒店示例，并比较两家下龙湾过夜游轮
对比国内航班、统一铁路火车、包车接送和湄公河行程，附日期、票价和耗时
独立重算每一笔金额，并对照来源清单核对每条说法
